Primary heat exchangers for water, oil and ICE intake air and any associated accessories, header tanks, connections to the ICE, tubes, pipes, hoses, and fixings
ICE-mounted ERS cooling system including pumps, secondary heat exchangers, associated motors, actuators, associated brackets, fixings, tubes, hoses

Fuel feed pumps delivering less than 10 barG and their associated accessories (included but not limited to tubes, hoses, supports, brackets, and fasteners).
Heat Shields and associated mounting hardware.

Intake upstream of compressor inlet/VG Intake device up to and including the air filter.

Any breather system ducting between the PU and the orifice referenced in 5.3.8.
Wiring harnesses attached to the PU which are not ordinarily part of a power unit (car looms)
Studs used to mount PU to chassis or gearbox.

Additional PUs or spares required to replace units out of service due to accident damage or other cause induced by team will be outside the supply perimeter and will incur additional charges
